latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(cli): detect corpus parse errors from the tree by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6030
* fix(lib): only match the whole name `ERROR` in `ts_language_symbol_for_name` by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6031
* fix(wasm): copy all supertype map entries by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6036
* fix: Windows symbol visibility backport by @WillLillis in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6051
* fix(lib): handle terminal ERROR nodes in `ts_node_has_error` by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6058
* fix(web): various issues by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6059
* fix(lib): reject symbol names with embedded `NULL` suffixes by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6073
* fix(lib): handle large child indices in reverse cursor traversal by @WillLillis in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6075
* fix(rust): address new `unnecessary-box-pin` lint by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6089
* fix(generate): preserve reserved-word behavior when merging states by @WillLillis in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6094
* fix(make): don't remove tree-sitter dir on `uninstall` by @tree-sitter-ci-bot[bot] in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6098
* backport zig by @clason in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6106
* build(deps): bump wasmtime-c-api to v48.0.8 by @clason in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6107
* release v0.27.2 by @clason in https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/pull/6108


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter/compare/v0.27.1...v0.27.2

detail.readme:
# tree-sitter

[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/14164618.svg)](https://zenodo.org/badge/latestdoi/14164618)
[![discord][discord]](https://discord.gg/w7nTvsVJhm)
[![matrix][matrix]](https://matrix.to/#/#tree-sitter-chat:matrix.org)

Tree-sitter is a parser generator tool and an incremental parsing library. It can build a concrete syntax tree for a source file and efficiently update the syntax tree as the source file is edited. Tree-sitter aims to be:

- **General** enough to parse any programming language
- **Fast** enough to parse on every keystroke in a text editor
- **Robust** enough to provide useful results even in the presence of syntax errors
- **Dependency-free** so that the runtime library (which is written in pure C) can be embedded in any application
